# Offline relocation of the previously frozen, Base-only task image.
# Full source/dependency reconstruction remains in environment/Dockerfile.
ARG BASE_IMAGE=sha256:aad47363477b6b2092e8d3ba616da14fc35a11af170bc19f8d26de7ef00bb107
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}
USER 0:0
WORKDIR /
RUN set -eu; \
    test ! -e /workspace/vllm; \
    mkdir -p /workspace; \
    chmod 755 /workspace; \
    mv /app /workspace/vllm; \
    site_dir="$(python3 -I -c 'import site; print(site.getsitepackages()[0])')"; \
    printf 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/vllm")\n' \
      > "${site_dir}/vllm-candidate-source.pth"; \
    test ! -e /app; \
    test "$(runuser -u agent -- git -C /workspace/vllm rev-parse HEAD)" = 676db55eecf8b6d9ec38ea243cf6f35ea8378ec6; \
    test "$(runuser -u agent -- git -C /workspace/vllm rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" = aafa39e6544cbeaf83b72985f83aaefd4e9e3456; \
    test -z "$(runuser -u agent -- git -C /workspace/vllm status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
WORKDIR /workspace/vllm
USER 10001:10001
RUN python3 -I -c 'import pathlib,torch,vllm; assert pathlib.Path(vllm.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to("/workspace/vllm"); assert torch.__version__.startswith("2.9.")' \
    && python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/v1/core/test_encoder_cache_manager.py
ENTRYPOINT []
CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]
